title: Pointwise finite pushforward detector over a Noetherian ring

from.place: Step 1 through Step 5 of the Noetherian case in Stacks Lemma 09Z6 (construct a pointwise detector and factor it through a finite pushforward)

statement: Let Λ be a Noetherian commutative ring, U a Noetherian scheme, and C a constructible Λ-module sheaf. For every point x of U there are a finite morphism f : Y → U, a finitely generated Λ-module M, and a map ψ : C → f_* constantSheaf(M) such that ψ is injective on every geometric stalk whose image in U is x.

proof.text: For each point x, apply the integral stalk embedding and then factor its map through a finite pushforward using finite presentability. The factor map remains injective on stalks because its composite with the transition map is injective. Use classical choice over x to assemble the finite data into the displayed indexed families.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09Z6 (3), pointwise detector, finite-stage factorization, and choice
